citation.author: Elpidorou, Andreas and Freeman, Lauren
citation.author_note: the source's own byline reads 'Lauren Freeman and Andreas Elpidorou' (Freeman first); cited here as 'Elpidorou & Freeman' for consistency with bor-sec-02 and the wider cluster manifest
citation.title: Affectivity in Heidegger II: Temporality, Boredom, and Beyond

discipline: philosophy (Heideggerian phenomenology of affectivity and temporality)
thesis: Any complete explication of Heidegger's account of Befindlichkeit/mood must specify its grounding in originary (ecstatic-horizonal) temporality; FE cash this out first for fear, anxiety, and hope via BT Division II §68, then at greater length for FCM's three forms of boredom -- each individuated by its distinct relation to how time passes (dragging / standing-still / entrancement) -- before closing with the post-1930 shift to historically oriented fundamental moods and a concluding valuation of Heidegger's affectivity account overall.

sections.title: Abstract
sections.summary: States the essay's three aims: revisit Befindlichkeit via Division-II temporality; discuss the Grundstimmung of boredom and its ontological significance; briefly characterize the post-1930 shift in Heidegger's notion of mood.

sections.title: 1. Befindlichkeit and Temporality -- 1.1 Dasein's Temporality
sections.summary: Care (existence/facticity/falling) as Dasein's structural whole, grounded in originary temporality; anticipatory resoluteness as the site where the ecstatic-horizonal unity of future/having-been/present becomes transparent; the ontological priority of the future.

sections.title: 1.2 The Temporality of Befindlichkeit: Having Been
sections.summary: Moods grounded primarily in the originary past; moods 'bring Dasein back to something,' disclosing the inherited burden of thrownness.

sections.title: 1.2.1 Fear, anxiety, and a bit of hope
sections.summary: Fear individuated from anxiety by mode of having-been (forgetting vs. repetition/Wiederholung); anticipation + repetition enable the authentic 'moment of vision' (Augenblick); hope, though apparently futural, is argued to be grounded in the past.

sections.title: 2. Boredom
sections.summary: Compressed exposition of FCM's three forms of Langeweile -- becoming-bored-by, being-bored-with, profound boredom -- individuated by their differential relation to 'how time passes' and ordered by increasing existential depth.

sections.title: 3. Moods in Heidegger's Later Thinking
sections.summary: Post-1930 shift from transcendental, Dasein-centric mood to historically oriented Grundstimmung; wonder (Erstaunen) as the mood of the first (Presocratic) beginning; reserve (Verhaltenheit) as the mood of a possible new beginning.

sections.title: 4. Conclusion
sections.summary: Valuation of Heidegger's (especially pre-1930) account of affectivity: its value lies in showing affectivity to be an irrevocable, constitutive dimension of human existence, inseparable from understanding, falling, and discourse.

constructs.label: profound/deep boredom (FCM 3rd form)
constructs.treatment: fullest treatment; entrancement melding all three temporal ecstases into an 'unarticulated unity'; depersonalized 'it is boring for one'; telling refusal discloses freedom and issues a call to resolute self-appropriation

constructs.label: being-bored-with (2nd form)
constructs.treatment: dinner-party example; arises from Dasein itself (not an external object); time stands still; an inauthentic modification of temporal existence; ranked more profound than the first form

constructs.label: being-bored-by (1st form)
constructs.treatment: briefest treatment via a substituted flight-delay example (FCM's own train-station scene not reused); left empty + held in limbo; time drags

constructs.label: temporality of boredom (time-drag)
constructs.treatment: the essay's true organizing construct: differentiates all three forms by their distinct temporal modification (dragging / standing-still / entrancing melding of the ecstases)

constructs.label: monotony / meaninglessness
constructs.treatment: subordinate theme; total withdrawal of significance in profound boredom, structurally echoing (not terminologically) anxiety's 'world sunk into insignificance'

constructs.label: boredom proneness
constructs.treatment: not treated -- outside this essay's purely exegetical register

constructs.label: boredom-as-regulatory-signal (functional account)
constructs.treatment: not named or discussed in functional/psychological terms, though profound boredom's freedom-disclosing 'call to action' is its phenomenological precursor (see readings/tensions below)

constructs.label: flow / engagement (contrast pole)
constructs.treatment: not treated as an explicit contrast pole

readings.claim: Originary temporality is the sense of Dasein's being and grounds care's threefold structure (existence, facticity, falling); it is ecstatic-horizonal and dynamically, not sequentially, unified, with the future holding ontological primacy.

Anticipatory resoluteness is the site where the ecstatic unity of temporality becomes transparent: authentic comportment toward one's own death discloses the 'primordial phenomenon of future' and requires a correlative retrieval of having-been.
Moods are grounded primarily, though not exclusively, in the originary past: they 'bring Dasein back to something,' disclosing the inherited burden of thrownness Dasein did not choose.

Fear is grounded in forgetting (an inauthentic having-been), releasing an inauthentic awaiting and a bewildered 'jumble of hovering' present; anxiety is grounded in repetition/retrieval (Wiederholung), releasing authentic anticipation and the moment of vision.
Hope, though apparently futural, is actually grounded in the past: to hope is to 'hope for something for oneself,' presupposing a prior relation to oneself as already thrown and burdened.

FCM's three forms of boredom are individuated by their distinct relation to how time passes -- dragging (1st), standing-still (2nd), and an entrancing melding of all three ecstases (3rd) -- each progressively more fundamental in what it discloses.

Profound boredom's total withdrawal of significance is not merely privative: the 'telling refusal' of beings as a whole is itself a making manifest that discloses Dasein's unexploited possibilities and freedom, issuing in a call to resolute self-appropriation rather than despair.

After 1930, Heidegger's notion of mood shifts from a Dasein-centric transcendental structure to an historically oriented one: fundamental moods (wonder, reserve) found entire epochs of Being rather than merely disclosing Dasein's own existence.

The value of Heidegger's (especially pre-1930) account of affectivity lies chiefly in showing affectivity to be an irrevocable, constitutive dimension of human existence, inseparable from understanding, falling, and discourse.

concepts.term: telling refusal (Versagen) as a making manifest (Sagen)
unarticulated unity (of the three temporal ecstases)
fundamental mood, later sense (Grundstimmung -- wonder/Erstaunen, reserve/Verhaltenheit)

tensions.axis: no succession among the temporal ecstases <-> the future's ontological primacy
tensions.note: Heidegger's own paradoxical formulation, faithfully reported by FE without resolution: temporalizing is not a 'succession' of the ecstases, yet the future is not simply co-equal with having-been and present -- it is named the 'primary meaning of existentiality.'

FE's own exposition stages this axis without naming it as a debate: the first form of boredom is caused 'from outside' by a determinate boring thing, while the second and third 'arise from out of Dasein itself' -- an unresolved but load-bearing asymmetry in FE's own account of increasing existential depth.

tensions.axis: profound boredom is boredom <-> profound boredom is a distinct existential mood (cluster debate-axis; not staged here)
tensions.note: FE's exposition in this essay is purely expository/non-adjudicating on this axis; the debate is only staged four years later in bor-sec-04, for which this essay's faithful third-form summary is the shared starting problematic (P/anticipatory-application -- our own forward link, not a claim FE make in 2015).
